protocol: JSC 20 Foot Chamber validation. Four crew and four age-, sex- and BMI-matched volunteers. Limited ambulation and supine simulated EVA tasks. Hyperbaric physician queried symptoms and cardiac ultrasound monitored VGE.
outcome_window: Observed ground-test window. A fixed post-exposure follow-up window is unreported.
note: The authors report no observed DCS symptoms across both ground and flight evaluations. Eight is the ground-test participant count. The crew also flew the subsequently revised profile. An exact number of chamber cycles and ultrasound grade counts are unreported.

protocol: Ambient-air exercise study with about 80 min at altitude. During treadmill exercise the chamber inadvertently descended to about 6,000 ft and returned to 15,000 ft in about 1.5 min.
outcome_window: Symptoms first reported about ten minutes after return to ground level. Pain absent the next day.
locator: Case history pp. 1080–1081 and Figure 1 p. 1081
note: One author-attributed case. The article provides the timing of the selected case and no denominator for an incidence estimate.
